game_updates.title: Where to find Holy Water in Palworld 1.0
game_updates.contents: A true endgame item, you need Holy Water to harvest World Tree resources and build some of the most powerful base items in the game. Read the full story on PCGamesN: Where to find Holy Water in Palworld 1.0

game_updates.title: Hotfix 1.6.1.514 is live!
game_updates.contents: Lord Captains, hotfix 1.6.1.514 is live! We've fixed a few annoying bugs often reported by the community: Fixed the epilogues abruptly ending in a few cases for the heretical conviction if certain choices were made; Glaito will no longer sometimes disappear after the Vheabos-VI mission; Fixed a loud weapon firing sound that sometimes could persist after cutscenes in the Infinite Museion; Using Furious Assault with Ogryn Grip sometimes led to the character being stuck in animation, not ending their turn - fixed. Note that https://steamcommunity.com/app/2186680/discussions/0/4027970580228219058/ always contains up-to-date information on known issues and the roadmap of upcoming patches. As usual, it may take up to 48 hours for this update to appear on consoles.

game_updates.title: Update Preview
game_updates.contents: Hey hey, Let me yap a little bit about what's coming to Manor Lords soon. Since we pushed our technical refactors to main, we are now ready to start pushing new features to beta. Construction YardWe divided Structures into Basic and Advanced. Advanced Structures will require skilled builders employed at the Construction Yard. Those builders have faster construction speed on basic structures too.The yard has multiple Handcarts for faster transportation of construction resources. It can also utilize Oxen with Ox Carts to bring multiple Timber logs in a single trip. Additionally, the Guides now have to actually load the Ox Cart. Large Stone Church The new Church upgrade makes the end game cityscape look even more realistic. We wanted to make the construction sites more lively as the process f...

game_updates.title: Every new Pal in Palworld 1.0 and where to catch them
game_updates.contents: The Palworld 1.0 update adds 72 new pals—most of which you can catch, while the remainder at least adds an updated entry to your Palpedia. That's a big undertaking with the expanded Palpagos map and the new World Tree region to explore, and referencing the in-game map can be a real pain, but that's where I come in to hopefully make the process a bit easier... Read more.

game_updates.title: For years, survival games have convinced us that chopping down 400 trees is somehow part of the fantasy—Palworld proves them wrong
game_updates.contents: Survival games are obsessed with the grind. Need a better axe? You've got to spend an hour collecting stone. Want to build a bigger base? Time to manually ferry hundreds of logs from one storage chest to another. Somewhere along the line, the genre started confusing friction with depth... Read more.

game_updates.title: Full Release 7.27.0 Released! (Experimental)
game_updates.contents: This update is only accessible by switching to our Experimental branches (instructions on how to do so here).Gameplay Changes:The Laser Weapons research entry has been updated so the displayed damage multiplier is now 120% rather than 135%, which accurately reflects the pre-upgrade damage values of Laser weapons. The research text has also been updated to better hint at the possibility of future upgrades.Mods now no longer have a "maximum version", as this was causing a lot of false confusion about mods being out of date. Generally speaking our "major version" patches should not break mods - so a mod made in V7 should work in all versions of post-release V7. The game now only generates a warning if we move onto the next major version (e.g. V8).Bugfixes:Fixed a rare crash that could occur w...

game_updates.title: Rainbow Six Siege Mid-Season Update: Everything You Need to Know
game_updates.contents: Operation System Override took Rainbow Six Siege by storm when it launched on June 2, bringing a major Dokkaebi rework, the new-yet-familiar Calypso Casino map, and a competitive overhaul with Ranked 3.0. Now, halfway through the season, the development team is implementing additional Operator balancing, mouse and keyboard support for consoles, a limited-time event, a Ranked map rotation, and rotating Operator trials.  1v1 Arcade Returns Today The fan-favorite limited-time event is back, bringing Siege’s intense tactical gameplay into a fast-paced, 1v1 duel environment. A pure test of your skill, the 1v1 arcade is filled with short, high-intensity matches that focus on gunplay, movement, and gadget skill. Gameplay was designed based on community feedback, and features shorter matches, less...

game_updates.title: Apex Legends: Latest Update - 07/15/2026
game_updates.contents: ✅FIXED: Banners will no longer appear in Wildcard death boxes.💡KNOWN ISSUE: Our team is aware of a bug causing the mirrored presentation of "SKIPPY" on the Mythic Alternator skin. While we are selective about which weapons receive this level of granular detail due to the complexity of texturing and weapon variations, the mirrored text was not intended in this specific case. The team is actively working on a fix and hopes to have it resolved soon. We'll circle back with an update once the issue has been addressed.
